verdict.rationale: Workspace export with full history is a fair question for a work management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities: BI-tool exports for analytics, raw analytical data access, and general API endpoints that a developer could use to build an export. Nothing documents a workspace export that preserves comments, attachments, and audit trails.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
